archetypes.name: dep-boundary
archetypes.rationale: Plan has a hard dependency on PR #3548 and marks several surfaces verify-only post-merge; a reviewer checking what #3548 already ships vs what this plan adds can catch instructions targeting already-landed code or gaps the verify-only default silently skips.
archetypes.prompt_body: Examine the plan's hard-dependency claim on PR #3548 and every surface explicitly marked 'verify-only post-#3548.' For each such surface check whether the described net-new delta is correctly scoped — specifically whether any plan instructions might re-implement or conflict with code already present on branch tip 0dc974f1e as documented in the plan's status block. Flag any instructions that appear to duplicate already-landed work, and any surfaces where the plan defaults to 'patch only proven gaps' without specifying how the implementer confirms the gap is actually absent. Verify that the approach section's 'verify-first' guidance is consistent with the per-file instructions for run-step3-review.sh and test-run-step3-review.sh, which give both a zero-line and a non-zero-line estimate. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: kv-wire
archetypes.rationale: The plan threads SCOPE_ANCHOR_FILE through five or more script boundaries each with distinct emit/parse/persist contracts and terminal conditions; field-name mismatches, missing allowlist arms, or error-terminal omission drift are primary sources of silent breakage that cross-file reading catches.
archetypes.prompt_body: Trace the SCOPE_ANCHOR_FILE KV as described in the plan from tally-plan-review.sh (emit on ok and main-agent-vote-required, omit on tally-error) through plan-review-loop.sh (input variable _STAGED_SCOPE_ANCHOR vs parsed output _PARSED_SCOPE_ANCHOR_FILE), run-step3-review.sh parse allowlist arms, SKILL.md Step 3 handoff case arms, and MainAgent re-tally dual-env refresh. Check whether every described emit terminal, parse allowlist arm, and env-write destination is internally consistent across all referenced files — look for field-name mismatches, allowlist arms mentioned in one file but not mirrored in another, or cases where the plan says 'parsed value only on ok' but also names main-agent-vote-required as a second terminal without equally explicit omit language for tally-error. Verify that the stale-seed test case described for test-plan-review-loop.sh explicitly covers the tally-error path and that the plan's FINDING_12 mitigation is traceable to concrete assertions in the named test harnesses. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
